mission: Recover Page Change Thread/Feed, Prometeo Execute, Capture and same-page return mechanisms; identify exact path to make the multi-surface control UI a real work surface.
route_changing_finding: Do not build a second page-message/return system. P4 already implements the page-scoped transport and same-page result loop. The swarm bridge should begin after P4 freezes an execution packet: adapt the existing thread/work_item/page identity plus scoped packet snapshot into planner/worker opportunities, then preserve the same work_item_id/thread_id through worker return and let P4 remain the canonical user-facing feed/return surface.

dedup_disposition.O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1: KEEP_AND_NARROW: active RECOVER run already owns bridge implementation; consume this archaeology and reuse P4 rather than rebuilding messaging/feed/return.
dedup_disposition.O-SWARM-CRITIC-TESTING-V1: REUSE_FOR_FALSIFICATION: existing critic lane can own browser/private-backend end-to-end falsification journeys; do not emit a duplicate verification opportunity from this run.
dedup_disposition.surface_local_integrations: KEEP_BLOCKED_BY_EXISTING_DEPENDENCIES: their one-message/same-surface acceptance criterion should be satisfied through P4 + bridge + local steward, not a surface-specific messaging fork.
